senses.gloss: (Saf. of דּוּר) to arrange, order (corresp. to b. h. ערך).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:2">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>סוֹדְרָן על הכוס</he> he pronounces them (the benedictions) in successive order over the cup.

<cite ref="Yoma 45b:1">Yoma 45ᵇ</cite> top <he>שסודרן ע״ג המזבח</he> that he must place them in order on the altar; <he>שסודרן על הכבש … וסודרן</he> that he must arrange them on the bridge or on the rim of the altar, until a large pile (of wood) is formed, when he must put them in order (on the altar); <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:1">Tam. II, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="O00181"><he>סָדוּר</he></cite>; f. <he>סְדוּרָה</he> &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 8a:1">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בשביל משנתו שאינה ס׳ עליו</he> it is because his learning is not properly systematised in his mind.

<cite ref="Berakhot 57a">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>עונותיו ס׳ לו</he> his sins are arranged before him; <he>מאי ס׳ ס׳ לימחל</he> what does this mean? It means that they are arranged (ready) to be forgiven; <cite ref="Yoma 88a">Yoma 88ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:3">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>אבנים הס׳ לגדר</he> stones arranged for erecting a fence, contrad. to <he>צבורות</he> piled up (v. <cite ref="O00411"><he>סָוַר</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="O00198">same</cite> <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:3">Tam. II, 3</cite> <he>לסַדֵּר אש המערכה</he> to arrange the pyre, v. <cite ref="M02179"><he>מַעֲרָכָה</he></cite>.
units: Num. R. s. 4 כיצד מְסַדְּרִין לחם וכ׳ how did they arrange the showbread?; ib. also מַסְדִּירִים, מַסְדִּירִין (Hif.); a. fr.—ס׳ שבח (cmp. ערך, Ps. V, 4, a. e.) to offer praise.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 7b:18">Ab. Zar. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 32a:32">Ber. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם יְסַדִּר אדם וכ׳</he> one should always offer praise to the Lord first, and then pray (for what he needs).

<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:10">Ib. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ראשונות דומה לעבד שמְסַדֵּר וכ׳</he> in the first three benedictions of the T’fillah one is like a servant that offers praise to his master; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01874"><he>מְסוּדָּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 95a">Men. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>במס׳</he> when everything in the Tabernacle was arranged, opp. <he>במסולק</he> when arrangements for moving were being made.

senses.gloss: (corresp. to העריך, Lev. XXVII, 8) to assess a person’s value with reference to the vower’s ability to pay, whence: to exempt from seizure (bed, tools &c.; v.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b:9">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>כדרך שמסדרין בערכין כך מסדרין בבעל חוב</he> as well as we allow an exemption from seizure in cases of vows, so we allow it in cases of debt; [Rashi quotes a Var. <he>משרדין</he>, v. <cite ref="U01932"><he>שָׂרַד</he></cite>].

<cite ref="Nedarim 65b:7">Ned. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>שמעת מינה אין מסדרין וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>משיירין</he>) from this you may deduce that no exemption is granted the debtor; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 114a:10">B. Mets. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו שיְסַדְּרוּ וכ׳</he> is a debtor allowed an exemption? Y. B. Kam. IX, 7ᵃ top <he>על מנת שלא לסַדֵּר מה וכ׳</he> with the condition that what my wife or my child wears is not to be exempted from seizure.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מסדרין לו מאותו החפץ</he> this special object is not exempted; a. e.

senses.gloss: to arrange, establish the order of. Num. R. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28b">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 17b">Meg. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ … על הסדר וכ׳</he> arranged the eighteen benedictions before Rabbi in the order in which they are to be recited. Sifra Tsav, Mill. <he>כשם שה׳ משה וכ׳</he> as Moses arranged the service of the Tabernacle, so he arranged &c.; a. e.
